input_evidence.summary: #9399 [Automation] native-image run fails for org.springframework:spring-aspects:6.0.0; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=8015

risks: The issue's failure log is truncated before the actual failing test/exception is shown, so the real native-image run error is unknown from the issue alone; the fixing agent must reproduce locally (checkMetadataFiles/test with GVM_TCK_LV=6.0.0) to see the actual failure before diagnosing.

A prior automated attempt at this same issue (branch ai/kimeta/human-intervention/issue-9399-...) reached this identical no_action preparation conclusion and was later escalated to human intervention — but the escalation happened during the fix phase's generate_tests() step over 'reporter-requested metadata' coverage, not because of missing setup, so it does not change this preparation decision.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: spring-aspects 6.0.0 resolves the identical org.aspectj:aspectjweaver:1.9.9.1 already used by 5.3.31 (verified from the resolved POM and cached jar), and every aspect the existing test exercises (AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect, AnnotationCacheAspect, AnnotationTransactionAspect, AnnotationAsyncExecutionAspect, GenericInterfaceDrivenDependencyInjectionAspect) is a compile-time-woven singleton accessed via the generated .aspectOf() method — none of it involves load-time weaving, a Java agent, a database, or an environment/system property. The generated scaffold (build.gradle, user-code-filter.json) mirrors the working 5.3.31 setup and needs nothing extra.
